# ECMWF cyclone fixtures

Native public ECMWF IFS Open Data BUFR files, retrieved 2026-09-09. ECMWF,
CC BY 4.0. Adjacent JSON records contain exact source URLs, SHA-256 digests and
retrieval receipts. The control file encodes native member 51. The ensemble
file encodes members 1–51. These are decoder fixtures, not current forecasts.

Spec-Refs: GOV-SPEC-001, GOV-SPEC-004, GOV-SPEC-006.
